"</code></pre>" if label == "" then return pre end return "<figure class=\"listing\">" .. caption_of(label) .. pre .. "</figure>" end function numbered_item(l) return re_find(l, "^[0-9]+\\. (.*)$") end function starts_block(l) return starts_with(l, FENCE) or starts_with(l, "#") or starts_with(l, "|") or starts_with(l, "- ") or starts_with(l, ">") or numbered_item(l) ~= nil end function cells_of(row) local inner = trim(row) inner = sub(inner, 2, #inner - 1) local cells = {} for c in split(inner, "|") do push(cells, trim(c)) end return cells end function table_html(rows) if #rows < 2 or re_find(rows[2], "^\\|[-| :]+\\|$") == nil then fail("book: a table without its `|---|` line: " .. rows[1]) end local out = {"<table>", "<thead><tr>"} for c in cells_of(rows[1]) do push(out, "<th>" .. inline_html(c) .. "</th>") end push(out, "</tr></thead>") push(out, "<tbody>") for r in drop(rows, 2) do push(out, "<tr>") for c in cells_of(r) do push(out, "<td>" .. inline_html(c) .. "</td>") end push(out, "</tr>") end push(out, "</tbody></table>") return join(out, "") end function rendered(ls, dir) local out = {} local i = 1 while i <= #ls do local l = ls[i] local heading = re_find(l, "^(#{1,3}) (.*)$") if trim(l) == "" then i = i + 1 elseif starts_with(l, FENCE) then local body = {} i = i + 1 while i <= #ls and trim(ls[i]) ~= FENCE do push(body, ls[i]) i = i + 1 end if i > #ls then fail("book: a fence with no end: " .. l) end i = i + 1 push(out, fence_html(sub(l, 4), body, dir)) elseif heading ~= nil then local level = "" .. #heading.groups[1] push(out, "<h" .. level .. " id=\"" .. slug_of(heading.groups[2]) .. "\">" .. inline_html(heading.groups[2]) .. "</h" .. level .. ">") i = i + 1 elseif starts_with(l, "|") then local rows = {} while i <= #ls and starts_with(ls[i], "|") do push(rows, ls[i]) i = i + 1 end push(out, table_html(rows)) elseif starts_with(l, ">") then local inner = {} while i <= #ls and starts_with(ls[i], ">") do push(inner, trim(sub(ls[i], 2))) i = i + 1 end push(out, "<blockquote>" .. rendered(inner, dir) .. "</blockquote>") elseif starts_with(l, "- ") or numbered_item(l) ~= nil then local ordered = not starts_with(l, "- ") local items = {} local going = true while going and i <= #ls do local item = nil if ordered then local m = numbered_item(ls[i]) if m ~= nil then item = m.group end elseif starts_with(ls[i], "- ") then item = sub(ls[i], 3) end if item ~= nil then push(items, item) elseif starts_with(ls[i], " ") and trim(ls[i]) ~= "" then items[#items] = items[#items] .. " " .. trim(ls[i]) else going = false end if going then i = i + 1 end end local tag = "ul" if ordered then tag = "ol" end local html = {"<" .. tag .. ">"} for item in items do push(html, "<li>" .. inline_html(item) .. "</li>") end push(html, "</" .. tag .. ">") push(out, join(html, "")) else local para = {trim(l)} i = i + 1 while i <= #ls and trim(ls[i]) ~= "" and not starts_block(ls[i]) do push(para, trim(ls[i])) i = i + 1 end push(out, "<p>" .. inline_html(join(para, " ")) .. "</p>") end end return join(out, "\n") end function plain(s) return html_escaped(re_replace(s, "`", "")) end function page(kind, book_title, title, body, pager, nav) return "<!doctype html>\n<html lang=\"en\">\n<head>\n<meta charset=\"utf-8\">\n" .. "<meta name=\"viewport\" content=\"width=device-width, initial-scale=1\">\n" .. "<title>" .. plain(title) .. "</title>\n<link rel=\"stylesheet\" href=\"book.css\">\n</head>\n<body class=\"" .. kind .. "\">\n" .. "<header class=\"top-bar\"><a href=\"index.html\">" .. plain(book_title) .. "</a><span>a how-to</span></header>\n" .. nav .. "<main>\n" .. body .. "\n" .. pager .. "\n</main>\n</body>\n</html>\n" end -- A rendered page's sections, `{id, title}`, from its `<h2>` lines. function sections_of(html) local found = {} for l in lines(html) do local m = re_find(l, "^<h2 id=\"([^\"]+)\">(.*)</h2>$") if m ~= nil then push(found, {id = m.groups[1], title = re_replace(m.groups[2], "<[^>]*>", "")}) end end return found end -- The chapter list beside a chapter: every chapter by number, the sections -- of chapter `n`, the one being read, and the index. function sidebar(book_title, chapters, n, sections) local ls = {"<nav class=\"book-nav\" aria-label=\"Chapters\">", "<a class=\"book-name\" href=\"index.html\">" .. plain(book_title) .. "</a>", "<ol>"} local i = 0 for c in chapters do i = i + 1 local file = "chapter-" .. i .. ".html" local link = "<a href=\"" .. file .. "\"><span class=\"number\">" .. i .. "</span>" .. plain(c.title) .. "</a>" if i == n then push(ls, "<li class=\"here\">" .. link .. "<ol class=\"sections\">") for s in sections do push(ls, "<li><a href=\"" .. file .. "#" .. s.id .. "\">" .. s.title .. "</a></li>") end push(ls, "</ol></li>") else push(ls, "<li>" .. link .. "</li>") end end push(ls, "</ol>") push(ls, "<a href=\"terms.html\">Index</a>") push(ls, "</nav>") return join(ls, "\n") .. "\n" end function pager(n, chapters) local before = "<span></span>" local after = "<a href=\"terms.html\">Index →</a>" if n > 1 then before = "<a href=\"chapter-" .. (n - 1) .. ".html\">← " .. plain(chapters[n - 1].title) .. "</a>" end if n < #chapters then after = "<a href=\"chapter-" .. (n + 1) .. ".html\">" .. plain(chapters[n + 1].title) .. " →</a>" end return "<nav class=\"pager\">" .. before .. "<a href=\"index.html\">Contents</a>" .. after .. "</nav>" end -- The contents page: the text under the title, then each chapter with its -- sections, then the index. function contents(book, dir) local ls = {"<h1>" .. plain(book.title) .. "</h1>", rendered(book.front, dir), "<ol class=\"contents\">"} local n = 0 for c in book.chapters do n = n + 1 local subs = {} local in_code = false for l in c.lines do if starts_with(l, FENCE) then in_code = not in_code end if not in_code and starts_with(l, "### ") then push(subs, "<li>" .. plain(sub(l, 5)) .. "</li>") end end push(ls, "<li><a href=\"chapter-" .. n .. ".html\">" .. plain(c.title) .. "</a><ol class=\"sections\">" .. join(subs, "") .. "</ol></li>") end push(ls, "</ol>") push(ls, "<p><a href=\"terms.html\">Index</a></p>") return join(ls, "\n") end -- A chapter's markdown: its title as the page's one `#` heading, and its -- `###` sections made `##`. function chapter_markdown(chapter) local out = {"# " .. chapter.title, ""} local in_code = false for l in chapter.lines do if starts_with(l, FENCE) then in_code = not in_code end if not in_code and starts_with(l, "### ") then push(out, "## " .. sub(l, 5)) else push(out, l) end end return out end -- The cookbook's negatives lint over book.md's own prose, its includes -- unexpanded, so a quoted file never counts. Each negative sentence is -- rewritten, or kept in NEGATIVES_TABLE with its kind. function negatives_findings() if not CHECK_NEGATIVES then return {} end local r = run({"shale", real(NEGATIVES), "manuscript=" .. SOURCE, "table=" .. NEGATIVES_TABLE}, {timeout_ms = 60000, tail = 200}) if r.ended == "exit" and get(r, "code", -1) == 0 then print(trim(r.out)) return {} end print(trim(r.out)) return {"the negatives lint found sentences to rewrite, above, or to keep in " .. NEGATIVES_TABLE} end -- A table row of the index with its last cell's chapter numbers made links. function linked_row(l) local cells = cells_of(l) if #cells < 4 or re_find(cells[#cells], "^[0-9, ]+$") == nil then return l end local links = {} for n in split(cells[#cells], ", ") do push(links, "[" .. n .. "](chapter-" .. n .. ".html)") end cells[#cells] = join(links, ", ") return "| " .. join(cells, " | ") .. " |" end -- The index's tables, from the cookbook's term index over the built book. -- Its report of smells after the tables is the writer's, so it goes to the -- build's output, and the page keeps the tables. function index_markdown(book_path) local r = run({"shale", real(TERM_INDEX), "book=" .. book_path, "terms=" .. TERMS}, {timeout_ms = 60000, head = 400}) if r.ended ~= "exit" or get(r, "code", -1) ~= 0 then print(trim(r.out)) fail("book: the term index failed") end local kept = {} local smells = {} local in_smells = false for l in lines(r.out) do if l == "# The smells" then in_smells = true end if in_smells then if trim(l) ~= "" and not starts_with(l, "|---") then push(smells, l) end elseif not starts_with(l, "── ") and l ~= "# The index" then push(kept, linked_row(l)) end end print(join(smells, "\n")) return kept end -- Every page answers from the channel, holding its own title. function check_channel(files) if CHANNEL == "" then return 0 end for f in keys(files) do local r = http_get(CHANNEL .. STAGE .. "/" .. f, {timeout_ms = 10000}) if r.status ~= 200 then fail("book: the channel answers " .. r.status .. " for " .. f) end if find(r.body, "<title>" .. files[f] .. "</title>") == nil then fail("book: the channel's " .. f .. " is another page") end end return #keys(files) end -- The gates come first, so the channel's copy changes only when every one -- passes: the includes as the source expands, the negatives lint, the -- prose on every page and the index's own page. local whole = expanded(read(SOURCE)) local lint = negatives_findings() local book = parts_of(whole) if #book.chapters == 0 then fail("book: book.md has no `##` chapters") end local dir = fresh_dir("scratch:", "book-build") replace(dir .. "/book.md", join(whole, "\n") .. "\n") local index = index_markdown(dir .. "/book.md") local rows = {{page = "index.html", prose = prose_words(book.front), title = plain(book.title)}} local n = 0 for c in book.chapters do n = n + 1 push(rows, {page = "chapter-" .. n .. ".html", prose = prose_words(c.lines), title = plain(c.title)}) end push(rows, {page = "terms.html", prose = prose_words(index), title = "Index"}) print(table(rows, {"page", "prose", "title"})) local over = {} for r in rows do if r.prose > MAX_PROSE_WORDS then push(over, r.page .. " (" .. r.prose .. " words)") end end for f in lint do print("lint: " .. f) end if #over > 0 then fail("book: over " .. MAX_PROSE_WORDS .. " words of prose: " .. join(over, ", ")) end if #lint > 0 then fail("book: " .. #lint .. " lint findings, above") end -- Every page is rendered before the channel's copy is replaced, so a block -- that fails to render or a diagram that fails to draw leaves it as it was. local pages = {} pages["index.html"] = page("front", book.title, book.title, contents(book, dir), "<nav class=\"pager\"><span></span><a href=\"chapter-1.html\">Start reading →</a></nav>", "") n = 0 for c in book.chapters do n = n + 1 local html = rendered(chapter_markdown(c), dir) local nav = sidebar(book.title, book.chapters, n, sections_of(html)) pages["chapter-" .. n .. ".html"] = page("chapter", book.title, c.title, html, pager(n, book.chapters), nav) end pages["terms.html"] = page("chapter", book.title, "Index", "<h1>Index</h1>\n" .. rendered(index, dir), "<nav class=\"pager\"><a href=\"chapter-" .. n .. ".html\">← " .. plain(book.chapters[n].title) .. "</a><a href=\"index.html\">Contents</a><span></span></nav>", sidebar(book.title, book.chapters, 0, {})) if exists(DEST) then remove_tree(DEST) end mkdir(DEST) replace(DEST .. "/book.css", read(CSS)) -- The book with every include filled in, for a reader who wants it in one file. copy(dir .. "/book.md", DEST .. "/book.md") remove_tree(dir) local served = {} for r in rows do replace(DEST .. "/" .. r.page, pages[r.page]) served[r.page] = r.title end print("book: " .. check_channel(served) .. " pages answer at the dev channel's /" .. STAGE .. "/")

name: books-book/examples/count_words.shale
html: -- Counts the words of prose in each chapter of the tiny book. local counts = {} for l in lines(read("books-book/examples/tiny_book.md")) do if starts_with(l, "## ") then push(counts, {chapter = sub(l, 4), words = 0}) elseif #counts > 0 and not starts_with(l, "{{") then counts[#counts].words = counts[#counts].words + #words(l) end end print(table(counts, {"chapter", "words"}))

name: books-book/examples/run_without_timeout.shale
html: -- Asks git for the three newest commits, and leaves out run's timeout. print(run({"git", "log", "--oneline"}, {tail = 3}).out)

name: books-book/build.shale, function anchored_line
html: -- The number of the one line of `ls` that holds `anchor`. The anchor must be -- there exactly once, so an edit that removes or repeats it stops the build. function anchored_line(ls, anchor, path) local at = 0 local seen = 0 local i = 0 for l in ls do i = i + 1 if contains(l, anchor) then seen = seen + 1 at = i end end if seen ~= 1 then fail("book: `" .. anchor .. "` is in " .. path .. " " .. seen .. " times, and an anchor must be there once") end return at end

name: roc-apps/canvas_apps/safari/tutorial/build.shale, function fenced_failure
html:
function fenced_failure(entry, roc, notes)
  local checked = run({roc, "check", basename(entry.program)},
    {cwd = dirname(entry.program), timeout_ms = 120000, whole = 1000000, want = WANT})
  local said = get(checked, "out", "")
  if errors_reported(said) == 0 then
    stop(entry, "roc check finds no error in " .. entry.program)
  end
  local program = trim(read(entry.program))
  local message = trim(join(split(said, real(".") .. "/"), ""))
  check_quoted(entry, program .. message)
  push(notes, {path = entry.program, parts = {whole_file_part(program)}})
  local file = basename(entry.program)
  return titled_block(file .. " (doesn't compile)", "roc", program) .. "\n\n" .. titled_block("roc check on " .. file, "text", message)
end

name: books-book/build.shale, the settings
html: -- Where the book's files are, from the checkout's root. const SOURCE = "books-book/book.md" const CSS = "books-book/book.css" const NEGATIVES_TABLE = "books-book/negatives.txt" const TERMS = "books-book/index_terms.txt" -- Where the pages go: the folder of the dev channel named STAGE. const STAGE = "books-book" const DEST = "build:roc-apps/next/" .. STAGE -- The web server over that folder, which the build asks for each page; "" -- skips the check, for a machine with no server running. const CHANNEL = "http://127.0.0.1:9210/" -- The taste gates. const MAX_PROSE_WORDS = 900 const CHECK_NEGATIVES = true

for r in rows do

end
